name: Shadowfang Keep

entrance.note: South of The Sepulcher on the Silverpine road. Questie dungeon entrance; same coords on dungeons:shadowfang-keep:run.

travel.how: From The Sepulcher walk south on the Silverpine road to the keep at 44.8, 67.8; Undercity is the Apothecarium stop for The Book of Ur, not a detour through Hillsbrad.

quests.name: Deathstalkers in Shadowfang
quests.notes: Turn in inside the instance (Vincent has no outdoor map point). Speedrun and balanced. Classic Era base XP at 25; Forever dungeon-quest bonus XP may be halved (unofficial).

quests.name: The Book of Ur
quests.notes: Balanced only in steps-v2. Book of Ur is in the library side room; extra Undercity trip. Classic Era base XP at 26.

quests.name: Arugal Must Die
quests.notes: Biggest Horde SFK XP quest; Head of Arugal from the last boss. Speedrun and balanced. Classic Era base XP at 27.

prep.group: Five-player, run once at 25. Do not reset for more worgs. At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour.
warnings: Forever: Fenrus summons Voidwalkers at 50% health; Wolf Master Nandos summons worgs (fan report).
Forever: Arugal's table book can give the Black Tome that leads to a secret boss in City of Dalaran (fan report, unofficial).
Courtyard and stair pulls are packed; Arugal Void Bolt needs line of sight.
Kill XP inside dungeons is increased; if any party member would get no XP because mobs are trivial, nobody gets XP (Forever hotfix).
Do not send the group through Southshore.
classQuests: Warlock 1740 The Orb of Soran'ruk: Large Soran'ruk Fragment drops from Shadowfang Darksouls inside SFK; the quest is cataloged under Blackfathom Deeps and has no dungeons:shadowfang-keep step ids.

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Same 20-30 band as SFK. Battle of Hillsbrad and the skull/named-NPC farms are the slow Tarren Mill work the dungeons-off text says to keep; drop them when the keep is run.
Late Barrens leftovers at the bottom of the SFK band. Guns of Northwatch and the Gilthares escort are the slowest 20-40 Barrens completes; skip if SFK is already covering 22-25.

sourceConflicts: research/nova/v2/silverpine-11-15.json is levels 11-15 and has no overlapping slow quests in the SFK 22-30 band.
QuestieDB Forever coords for Hadrec are 43.42, 40.86 and Dalar 44.2, 39.81; dungeons.json uses 43.4, 40.9 and 44.2, 39.8.
Forever Fenrus/Nandos/Black Tome changes are fan-reported (wowclassicforever.info), not Blizzard-published.
notes: Three Horde quests in dungeons.json, all with steps in steps-v2.json. Pickup at The Sepulcher around 20-25; Book of Ur is the only Undercity extra. Dungeons off: stay on Silverpine leftovers and Tarren Mill. Classic XP from Questie/quests.json; Forever live XP unverified.
